confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are fairly well supported. Five price searches returned summaries citing Numbeo's Tallinn data (inexpensive meal about EUR 15, mid-range three-course meal for two about EUR 80, 0.5 L domestic draft about EUR 6, cappuccino about EUR 3.96) and Expatistan's Tallinn data (cappuccino about EUR 4.19, pub beer about EUR 4.82, lunch menu about EUR 13). The two sources broadly agree. I relied on the search summaries and did not open the pages myself. EUR figures were converted at an assumed rate of about 1.16 USD per EUR, which I did not verify separately. Cocktail and wine are weaker. The cocktail estimate rests on Expatistan's about EUR 11 for a downtown club and a guide's EUR 8-14 range, roughly 1.8x beer. The wine-glass estimate rests on a guide's EUR 6-14 range and roughly 1.15x beer, because I found no aggregated restaurant price per glass. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge for July peak season, not inspected listings, and could be off by 20-25%.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Tallinn's own aggregated price data, not a proxy city. Accommodation is benchmarked from general knowledge against Baltic and Nordic neighbours. Tallinn summer lodging is typically in line with or somewhat above Riga and Vilnius, and well below Helsinki and Stockholm.
